name: Chat and message timeline
description:
1. Started from a `@mockups` request: built a DevTools-style waterfall mockup (`design/07-chat-timeline/`) to visualise a message's processing events — start, send, tool, subtask, error, LLM wait.
2. Implemented it in the real chat as `ChatTurnTimeline.vue`, replacing the "read" progress bar, then moved it into the sticky message header with one colour per event type and tabs (Events table / Tools).
3. Fixed two verified defects found in the browser: only the left third of the bar was clickable (counter and chevron outside the toggle), and the panel opened off-screen due to CSS sticky containment; then refactored the Tools tab to match the Events table's dense reading.
4. Produced three message-header redesign mockups (`design/08-message-header/`) with a design note: grouped popover (recommended), action palette, inline toolbar.
5. Root-caused the "almost only tools" problem: the backend bridge discarded `LLM_REQUEST`/`LLM_CHUNK`/`LLM_USAGE` and tool timestamps, so live waits and dead turns looked identical — added `PhaseEvent` + real timestamps and wiring, then completed the client refactor (health banner above the tabs, real phase geometry, idle slices, interruptions), verified live, **but the API container is still running the old bridge and no LLM phase has reached disk yet** — that restart and end-to-end test is the open item.

messages.content:
@mockups show me a mockup of a timeline graph or viz to use in the chats and messages to visualize their processing events:
 - start
 - message send
 - tool_event
 - subtask
 - error
 - reading response
 - ..

It will be like the dev chrome tools timelines visualizations where we can spot potential issus.

Create mockup

I'll start by orienting myself and finding the existing mockups.Now I have the real event model (`LifeCycleEvent`, `ToolEvent`, `AgentEventType`) and the authoritative design system. Writing the mockup.File written. Now let me verify it actually runs (JS errors, layout) in a real browser.Two defects found in the failed turn: duplicated/incorrectly-labelled error insights, and a fragile keyboard guard. Fixing both.Verified end-to-end in the browser. Now the feature README and the design-folder index entry.Mockup is built, running and verified in the live browser.

## What I created

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `design/07-chat-timeline/01-mockup/index.html` | The mockup — one file, no build, no CDN, opens anywhere |
| `design/07-chat-timeline/README.md` | Feature design: lanes, mock API contract, mapping to the real `ToolEvent` / `LifeCycleEvent` models, insight rules, open questions |
| `design/README.md` | New row pointing at `07-chat-timeline/` |

**Live view:** http://gbrian.codxjunior.com/browser/b537d1d5-1db7-4517-8c3b-2fb3044ecdd4/ (left open on the slow turn for you)

## The viz

DevTools-waterfall, not a list:

- **Lanes** share one time axis — `Events` (instant markers: message sent → run error → done), `Turn` (root bar), `LLM` (hatched *waiting for first token* + solid *reading response/stream*), `Tools` (one row per call), `Subtasks`, `Storage` (persist / sio emit).
- **In-message strip** — an 11px compressed version of the same turn inside the assistant bubble (`93.4s · 3 LLM · 6 tools`), click → full panel. That's the "use it in chats and messages" half.
- **Insights rail** — computed from the events, not hard-coded: run/tool/LLM failures, slow tool (>5s), **silent gap** (>8s with no progress heartbeat), repeated tool+args, slow TTFT (>2.5s), subtask holding the turn open, retry-after-error, low throughput. Clicking an insight selects the event **and zooms the axis to it**.
- **Details rail** — args, response, timings, error, Copy JSON.
- **Controls** — wheel zoom, drag pan, minimap brush, Fit, **Replay** (re-draws the turn in ~13s with a playhead), category filters, `↑/↓` walk events, `F` fit.
- **3 turns** to demo: healthy (7 insights → *No anomalies detected* empty state), slow (7 issues incl. a 37.8s stall), failed (5 issues, errors land on the exact bar).

## Verified in the browser (not just claimed)

Rendered 11 bars/lanes + markers; insight counts 7 / 0 / 5 per turn after I fixed two defects found this way (duplicate "Run failed" rows and mis-labelled LLM/persist errors); event selection, insight jump (`0.00s → 21.16s`), zoom/fit, filters, replay (11 pending bars + playhead), keyboard walk, tool-row collapse, turn switch, **Force error → HTTP 500 state → Retry**, localStorage restore, and no horizontal overflow at 1024px.

Two notes: the mock uses the **magenta** tokens from `design/01-brand/color-system.md` (the indigo in the Mockups profile is the palette the colour doc retires), and the timeline is design-only — no product component touched.

# codx-junior — Design Documentation

Corporate image and UI/UX foundation for **codx-junior**, derived from an audit of the
shipping product (`client/` — project `codx-junior-ui`).

> **Status:** v0.1 — *baseline definition*. Everything here describes either
> (a) what the product does **today**, verified in code, or (b) a **decision
> proposal** to close a gap. Each statement is labelled so the two never get
> confused.

> **Start here — [`playbook/index.html`](playbook/index.html).** The whole design system on
> one self-contained page: live component specimens, dark/light toggle, print-ready layout.
> Hand it to any developer before they write UI code.

---

## Why this folder exists

codx-junior grew feature-first: 400+ Vue components, several parallel shells
(desktop dockview, mobile app shell, company shell, solopreneur shell) and three
different colour palettes that leaked into the codebase over time. The product
works, but it does not yet look like *one company*.

This folder is the single place where the corporate image is defined, so that:

- a new screen can be designed without inventing new colours, spacing or copy;
- a designer and a developer can agree on a spec without a meeting;
- rebrand work (logo, palette, marketing site) has a contract to break *on purpose*.

| `03-ux/` | Information architecture, navigation model, accessibility | Designers, PMs, frontend |
| `04-assets/` | Asset production rules: formats, sizes, naming, export | Design, marketing |
| `05-governance/` | Ownership, versioning, review checklist, adoption roadmap | Leads |
| `06-calendar/` | **Feature design** — agenda/calendar manager: deep analysis, clickable prototype, API fixtures. Design only, no code changed | Product, frontend, backend |
| `tokens/` | `design-tokens.json` — machine-readable source for the values above | Frontend |

Reading order for a newcomer: **audit → brand platform → colour → typography →

# Colour System

**Status:** tokens defined here; **not yet wired into the codebase**
(see `00-audit/ui-audit.md` §2). Until they are, the app runs on stock daisyUI themes.

Contrast ratios below are computed with the WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance formula
against the stated backgrounds. They are reproducible: keep the function in
`design/tokens/contrast.md` honest if values change.

## 1. The error we are correcting

Three palettes currently coexist:

| Source | Primary | Problem |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `client/src/assets/main.css` (live) | `#CC0099` | Applied only to `.codx-primary` / `.text-codx-secondary` |
| `client/src/assets/daisy-override.css` (dead) | `#CC049C` | Re-tints 35 themes with a *near-miss* of the brand magenta |
| `client/.codx/profiles/Designer/Designer.md` | `#6366F1` (indigo) | A completely different, cool-toned palette |

`#CC0099` vs `#CC049C` is a **3/255 difference in one channel** — invisible to the eye,
but it means "brand colour" is not a single value in the repo. The Designer profile's
indigo was never implemented and must be retired.

**Decision:** `#CC0099` is the brand magenta. `#CC049C` is retired. Indigo is deleted
from the design vocabulary.

---

### Magenta (primary signature)

<style>
  /* ── design tokens (design/01-brand/color-system.md) ─────────────────── */
  :root{

  .dot{ width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto }
  .dot.ok{ background:var(--success) } .dot.warn{ background:var(--warning) } .dot.err{ background:var(--error) } .dot.run{ background:var(--info); animation:pulse 1.4s infinite }

  .pill{ display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:22px;padding:0 8px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);font:600 11px/1 var(--ui);
         background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--text) 7%, transparent); color:var(--text-2) }

  /* ── layout ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  .wrap{ max-width:1380px; margin:0 auto; padding:18px 20px 64px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px }
  .card{ background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-lg); box-shadow:var(--shadow); overflow:hidden }
  .card-head{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:12px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft); flex-wrap:wrap }

  .bubble{ background:var(--surface-2); border:1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius:10px; padding:9px 12px; font-size:13px; color:var(--text-2) }
  .msg.user .bubble{ background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--info) 10%, transparent); border-color:color-mix(in oklab, var(--info) 22%, transparent) }

  .msg-foot{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin-top:9px; padding-top:9px; border-top:1px dashed var(--border-soft); flex-wrap:wrap }

  .panel-body{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 344px; gap:14px; padding:0 16px 16px }
  .tl{ --gutter:154px; min-width:0; border:1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius:var(--r-md); overflow:hidden; background:var(--sunken) }

  }

  .bar.k-tool{ background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--success) 72%, transparent) }

  /* ── right rail ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  .rail{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; min-width:0 }
  .rail-card{ background:var(--sunken); border:1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius:var(--r-md); overflow:hidden }

  .detail{ padding:11px }

           background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--error) 14%, transparent); border:1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--error) 32%, transparent); color:color-mix(in oklab, var(--error) 78%, white) }
  .detail-actions{ display:flex; gap:6px; margin-top:10px; flex-wrap:wrap }

  /* ── states ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  .skeleton{ padding:16px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:9px }
  .sk-row{ height:13px; border-radius:5px; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--surface-2), color-mix(in oklab, var(--text) 9%, transparent), var(--surface-2)); background-size:220% 100%; animation:shimmer 1.3s linear infinite }
  @keyframes shimmer{ 0%{background-position:120% 0} 100%{background-position:-120% 0} }
  .state{ padding:30px 18px; text-align:center }
  .state h3{ margin:8px 0 4px; font:650 14px/1.2 var(--ui) }
  .state p{ margin:0 0 14px; font-size:12px; color:var(--text-3) }
  .state .i{ width:26px; height:26px; margin:0 auto; display:block; color:var(--error) }

  /* ── tooltip + toast ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  #tooltip{
    position:fixed; z-index:60; pointer-events:none; opacity:0; transform:translateY(4px);
    transition:opacity 120ms, transform 120ms;
    max-width:290px; padding:7px 9px; border-radius:8px;

  @media (max-width:1080px){

 */

  return {
    id: 'e' + (++_eid),
    kind, lane, label,
    start: S(start),
    dur: dur == null ? null : S(dur),

/* MOCK: turn 1 — a healthy turn (no anomalies) */

const TURN_SLOW = {

/* MOCK: turn 3 — tool errors then a run error */
const TURN_ERROR = {
  id: 't_C', name: 'Failed turn', chat_id: 'chat_9a41', started_at: '09:13:43',
  model: 'gpt-4.1', profiles: ['Mockups'], duration: S(14.88),
  events: [
    ev('message', 'events', 'Message sent', 0, null, 'ok', { role: 'user', chars: 96, mentions: '—' }),
    ev('run', 'turn', 'Turn', 0.04, 14.84, 'error', { run_id: 'run_c1d4e7', agent: 'smol', model: 'gpt-4.1', status: 'error', error: 'loop guard: 3 consecutive tool failures' }),
    ev('llm', 'llm', 'round 1', 0.15, 3.45, 'ok', { model: 'gpt-4.1', prompt_tokens: 5210, completion_tokens: 288, ttft: 420, tps: 88 }),
    ev('tool', 'tools', 'project_read_file', 3.70, 0.28, 'error', { args: { file: 'client/src/foo.vue' }, error: 'File not found: client/src/foo.vue', cached: false }),
    ev('tool', 'tools', 'project_read_file', 4.10, 0.24, 'ok', { args: { file: 'client/src/App.vue' }, response: '312 lines', cached: false }),
    ev('llm', 'llm', 'round 2', 4.40, 4.60, 'ok', { model: 'gpt-4.1', prompt_tokens: 6120, completion_tokens: 341, ttft: 860, tps: 91 }),
    ev('tool', 'tools', 'docker_exec', 9.20, 0.70, 'error', { args: { container: 'codx-api', command: 'ls /app' }, error: 'container "codx-api" is not running', cached: false }),
    ev('llm', 'llm', 'round 3', 9.95, 4.20, 'error', { model: 'gpt-4.1', prompt_tokens: 6840, completion_tokens: 122, ttft: 940, tps: 41, error: 'stream interrupted: tool loop guard' }),
    ev('error', 'events', 'Run error', 14.20, null, 'error', { error: 'loop guard: 3 consecutive tool failures', recoverable: false }),
    ev('persist', 'io', 'persist message', 14.60, 0.011, 'error', { bytes: 6120, store: 'ChatManager.update_message', note: 'persisted with error' }),
    ev('error', 'events', 'Turn failed', 14.88, null, 'error', { duration_ms: 14840 })
  ]
};

const TURNS = { t_A: TURN_HEALTHY, t_B: TURN_SLOW, t_C: TURN_ERROR };

/* MOCK: chat thread — messages point at the turn that produced them */
const CHAT = {
  id: 'chat_9a41',
  name: 'Timeline graph for chats and messages',
  project: 'codx-junior-platform',
  messages: [
    { id: 'm1', role: 'user', user: 'xavier', at: '09:12:04',
      content: '@mockups show me a mockup of a timeline graph to visualise the processing events of a message: start, message send, tool_event, subtask, error, reading response…' },
    { id: 'm2', role: 'assistant', turnId: 't_B', at: '09:12:06',
      content: 'Built a DevTools-style waterfall: one lane per concern (turn, LLM round, each tool, subtask, storage), plus an insights rail that flags slow tools, silent gaps and repeated calls.',
      files: ['design/07-chat-timeline/01-mockup/index.html'] },
    { id: 'm3', role: 'user', user: 'xavier', at: '09:13:41',
      content: 'nice — and when the turn fails, does it show where it broke?' },
    { id: 'm4', role: 'assistant', turnId: 't_C', at: '09:13:43',
      content: 'Yes — errors land on the exact bar (tool, LLM stream or run) and the insight row jumps to it. This turn died on the tool loop guard.' }
  ]
};

/* ============================================================================
   B. MOCK SERVER — single fetch interception, latency + failure injection
   ============================================================================ */
const nowIso = () => new Date().toISOString();
const jsonResponse = (data, status = 200) =>
  ({ ok: status >= 200 && status < 300, status, json: async () => data });

const routes = [
  { method: 'GET', path: /^\/api\/chats\/([^/]+)\/messages$/, handler: () => ({ chat: CHAT }) },
  { method: 'GET', path: /^\/api\/chats\/([^/]+)\/turns\/([^/]+)\/timeline$/, handler: ({ params }) => {
      const turn = TURNS[params[1]];
      return turn ? { ...turn, insights: computeInsights(turn), served_at: nowIso() } : null;
    } }
];

function mockFetch(url, init) {
  init = init || {};
  const { pathname } = new URL(url, location.origin);
  const method = (init.method || 'GET').toUpperCase();
  const route = routes.find(r => r.method === method && r.path.test(pathname));
  const failForced = new URL(url, location.origin).searchParams.get('_fail') === '1';

  return new Promise(resolve => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (failForced) return resolve(jsonResponse({ error: 'internal_server_error', detail: 'mock failure injected by the dev switch' }, 500));
      if (!route) return resolve(jsonResponse({ error: 'not_found' }, 404));
      const params = pathname.match(route.path).slice(1);
      const result = route.handler({ params });
      resolve(result == null ? jsonResponse({ error: 'not_found' }, 404) : jsonResponse(result));
    }, 160 + Math.random() * 260);
  });
}

/* ============================================================================
   C. STATE
   ============================================================================ */
const LS_KEY = 'mock.codx.timeline.v1';

const state = {
  turn: null,
  turnId: 't_B',
  loading: true,
  error: null,
  forceFail: false,
  showStrip: true,
  selectedId: null,
  view: { start: 0, end: 1 },
  filters: { llm: true, tool: true, subtask: true, io: true, events: true },
  toolsOpen: true,
  replay: { t: null, playing: false, raf: 0, last: 0 },
  insights: []
};

function saveState() {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify({
      turnId: state.turnId, filters: state.filters, toolsOpen: state.toolsOpen, showStrip: state.showStrip
    }));
  } catch (e) { /* storage may be blocked — mockup keeps working */ }
}
function loadState() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY);
    if (!raw) return;
    const p = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (p.turnId && TURNS[p.turnId]) state.turnId = p.turnId;
    if (p.filters) state.filters = Object.assign(state.filters, p.filters);
    if (typeof p.toolsOpen === 'boolean') state.toolsOpen = p.toolsOpen;
    if (typeof p.showStrip === 'boolean') state.showStrip = p.showStrip;
  } catch (e) { /* ignore corrupt state */ }
}

/* ============================================================================
   D. HELPERS
   ============================================================================ */
const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v));
const fmtDur = ms => ms == null ? '—' : (ms < 1000 ? Math.round(ms) + 'ms' : (ms / 1000).toFixed(ms < 10000 ? 2 : 1) + 's');
const fmtT = ms => (ms / 1000).toFixed(2) + 's';
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({ '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"' }[c]));
const icon = (n, cls) => `<svg class="i ${cls || ''}" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-${n}"/></svg>`;
const kindIcon = k => ({ message: 'flag', run: 'clock', llm: 'zap', tool: 'wrench', subtask: 'branch', persist: 'db', socket: 'db', error: 'alert', done: 'check' }[k] || 'info');
const groupOf = k => (k === 'message' || k === 'done' || k === 'error') ? 'events'
  : (k === 'persist' || k === 'socket') ? 'io' : k === 'run' ? 'turn' : k;

function pct(t, view) { return clamp((t - view.start) / (view.end - view.start) * 100, -400, 400); }

function ticksFor(view) {
  const span = view.end - view.start;
  const steps = [100, 200, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 2500, 5000, 10000, 15000, 20000, 30000, 60000];
  const step = steps.find(s => span / s <= 9) || 60000;
  const first = Math.ceil(view.start / step) * step;
  const list = [];
  for (let t = first; t <= view.end; t += step) list.push(t);
  return { step, list };
}
const tickLabel = (t, step) => step >= 1000 ? (t / 1000).toFixed(step >= 10000 ? 0 : 1) + 's' : t + 'ms';

/* ── derived numbers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function summarize(turn) {
  const t = turn.events;
  const sum = k => t.filter(e => groupOf(e.kind) === k || e.kind === k).reduce((n, e) => n + (e.dur || 0), 0);
  const llm = t.filter(e => e.kind === 'llm').reduce((n, e) => n + (e.dur || 0), 0);
  const tool = t.filter(e => e.kind === 'tool').reduce((n, e) => n + (e.dur || 0), 0);
  const sub = t.filter(e => e.kind === 'subtask').reduce((n, e) => n + (e.dur || 0), 0);
  const io = t.filter(e => e.kind === 'persist' || e.kind === 'socket').reduce((n, e) => n + (e.dur || 0), 0);
  const prompt = t.reduce((n, e) => n + (e.meta.prompt_tokens || 0), 0);
  const completion = t.reduce((n, e) => n + (e.meta.completion_tokens || 0), 0);
  const cost = prompt / 1e6 * 3 + completion / 1e6 * 15;
  const busy = llm + tool + sub + io;
  return {
    total: turn.duration, llm, tool, sub, io,
    idle: Math.max(0, turn.duration - busy),
    prompt, completion, cost,
    tools: t.filter(e => e.kind === 'tool').length,
    rounds: t.filter(e => e.kind === 'llm').length,
    errors: t.filter(e => e.status === 'error').length
  };
}

/* ── insights engine (deterministic rules, computed from the events) ────── */
function computeInsights(turn) {
  const out = [];
  const evs = turn.events;
  const ordered = evs.filter(e => e.lane !== 'turn' && e.lane !== 'events').sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);

  // 1. hard failures
  evs.filter(e => e.status === 'error').forEach(e => {
    const isRun = e.kind === 'run' || e.kind === 'error';
    out.push({
      severity: 'error', at: e.start, eventId: e.id,
      title: isRun ? 'Run failed' : 'Tool error · ' + e.label,
      detail: (e.meta.error || 'unknown error') + (isRun ? ' — the turn stopped here.' : ' — the agent kept going with an error in its context.')
    });
  });

  // 2. slow tools (> 5s)
  evs.filter(e => e.kind === 'tool' && e.status !== 'error' && (e.dur || 0) > 5000).forEach(e => {
    out.push({
      severity: 'warning', at: e.start, eventId: e.id,
      title: 'Slow tool · ' + e.label,
      detail: 'Took ' + fmtDur(e.dur) + ' (threshold 5.0s) — ' + Math.round((e.dur || 0) / 5000 * 10) / 10 + '× the budget.'
    });
  });

  // 3. silent gaps (> 8s with no event)
  let cursor = 0;
  ordered.forEach(e => {
    const gap = e.start - cursor;
    if (gap > 8000) {
      const prev = ordered.filter(x => x.start + (x.dur || 0) <= cursor).pop();
      out.push({
        severity: 'warning', at: cursor, eventId: e.id,
        title: 'Silent gap · ' + fmtDur(gap),
        detail: 'No event between ' + fmtT(cursor) + ' and ' + fmtT(e.start) + (prev ? ' (after ' + prev.label + ')' : '') +
                ' — no progress heartbeat, so a stall looks exactly like this.'
      });
    }
    cursor = Math.max(cursor, e.start + (e.dur || 0));
  });

  // 4. repeated tool + identical arguments
  const seen = new Map();
  evs.filter(e => e.kind === 'tool').forEach(e => {
    const key = e.label + '|' + JSON.stringify(e.meta.args || {});
    if (seen.has(key)) {
      const prev = seen.get(key);
      out.push({
        severity: 'warning', at: e.start, eventId: e.id,
        title: 'Repeated call · ' + e.label,
        detail: 'Identical tool + arguments ran again ' + fmtDur(e.start - prev.start) + ' later: ' +
                fmtDur(prev.dur) + ' + ' + fmtDur(e.dur) + ' wasted — the tool cache did not answer it.'
      });
    } else seen.set(key, e);
  });

  // 5. slow first token (> 2.5s)
  evs.filter(e => e.kind === 'llm' && (e.meta.ttft || 0) > 2500).forEach(e => {
    out.push({
      severity: 'warning', at: e.start, eventId: e.id,
      title: 'Slow first token · ' + fmtDur(e.meta.ttft),
      detail: 'The user stares at a spinner for ' + fmtDur(e.meta.ttft) + ' before any text arrives (threshold 2.5s).'
    });
  });

  // 6. low streaming throughput (< 45 tok/s)
  evs.filter(e => e.kind === 'llm' && (e.meta.tps || 999) < 45).forEach(e => {
    out.push({
      severity: 'info', at: e.start, eventId: e.id,
      title: 'Low throughput · ' + e.meta.tps + ' tok/s',
      detail: 'Streaming was slower than 45 tok/s for this round — reading feels sluggish.'
    });
  });

  // 7. subtask holding the turn open (> 15s)
  evs.filter(e => e.kind === 'subtask' && (e.dur || 0) > 15000).forEach(e => {
    out.push({
      severity: 'warning', at: e.start, eventId: e.id,
      title: 'Subtask blocks the turn · ' + fmtDur(e.dur),
      detail: e.meta.llm_rounds + ' LLM rounds and ' + e.meta.tool_calls + ' tool calls ran inside ' +
              e.meta.chat_id + ' while the parent turn waited.'
    });
  });

  // 8. retry after a tool error
  evs.filter(e => e.kind === 'tool').forEach((e, i, arr) => {
    const prev = arr[i - 1];
    if (prev && prev.status === 'error' && e.status !== 'error' && e.start - (prev.start + prev.dur) < 1000) {
      out.push({
        severity: 'info', at: e.start, eventId: e.id,
        title: 'Retried after error · ' + e.label,
        detail: 'The agent recovered by calling the tool again with different arguments (' + fmtDur(e.dur) + ').'
      });
    }
  });

  const rank = { error: 0, warning: 1, info: 2 };
  return out.sort((a, b) => rank[a.severity] - rank[b.severity] || a.at - b.at);
}

/* ============================================================================
   E. RENDER
   ============================================================================ */
let barNodes = new Map();   // eventId -> element (for replay without re-render)
let playheads = [];

function render() {
  renderChat();
  renderPanel();
}

/* ── E.1 the chat (in-message strip) ────────────────────────────────────── */
function stripHTML(turn) {
  const d = turn.duration || 1;
  const segs = turn.events.filter(e => (e.dur || 0) > 0 && ['llm', 'tool', 'subtask', 'persist', 'socket'].includes(e.kind));
  const inner = segs.map(e => {
    const left = e.start / d * 100;
    const w = Math.max(e.dur / d * 100, 0.5);
    return `<span class="strip-seg k-${e.kind}" style="left:${left.toFixed(2)}%;width:${w.toFixed(2)}%" title="${esc(e.label)} · ${fmtDur(e.dur)}"></span>`;
  }).join('');
  return `<div class="strip" data-action="select-turn" data-turn="${turn.id}" role="button" tabindex="0"
    aria-label="Turn ${esc(turn.name)}: ${fmtDur(turn.duration)}, ${segs.length} segments. Open the full timeline.">${inner}</div>`;
}

function renderChat() {
  const el = document.getElementById('chat-body');
  const rows = CHAT.messages.map(m => {
    const turn = m.turnId ? TURNS[m.turnId] : null;
    const sum = turn ? summarize(turn) : null;
    const active = turn && turn.id === state.turnId;
    const body = esc(m.content).replace(/@(\w+)/g, '<span class="mention">@$1</span>');
    const foot = turn && state.showStrip ? `
      <div class="msg-foot">
        <span class="lbl">${turn.id === state.turnId ? icon('clock') : ''}</span>
        <div class="strip-wrap">${stripHTML(turn)}</div>
        <span class="lbl mono">${fmtDur(turn.duration)}</span>
        <span class="lbl">${sum.rounds} LLM · ${sum.tools} tools${sum.errors ? ' · ' + sum.errors + ' err' : ''}</span>
        <button class="linkish" data-action="select-turn" data-turn="${turn.id}">
          ${icon('chevron-r')} Open timeline${active ? ' (shown)' : ''}
        </button>
      </div>` : '';
    const files = (m.files || []).map(f => `<div class="lbl mono" style="font-size:10.5px">${icon('copy')} ${esc(f)}</div>`).join('');
    return `
      <div class="msg ${m.role}">
        <div class="avatar ${m.role}">${m.role === 'user' ? 'X' : 'cj'}</div>
        <div>
          <div class="msg-meta">
            <span>${esc(m.user || 'codx-junior')}</span><span>·</span><span>${esc(m.at)}</span>
            ${turn ? `<span class="pill ${turn.id === state.turnId ? 'ok' : ''}">${esc(turn.name)}</span>` : ''}
          </div>
          <div class="bubble">${body}${files}</div>
          ${foot}
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');
  el.innerHTML = rows;
}

/* ── E.2 the panel shell ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function renderPanel() {
  const head = document.getElementById('panel-head');
  const body = document.getElementById('panel-body');

  if (state.loading) {
    head.innerHTML = '';
    body.innerHTML = `<div class="skeleton" style="grid-column:1/-1">
      <div class="sk-row" style="width:46%"></div>
      <div class="sk-row" style="width:78%"></div>
      <div class="sk-row" style="width:100%;height:120px"></div>
      <div class="sk-row" style="width:64%"></div>
    </div>`;
    return;
  }
  if (state.error) {
    head.innerHTML = '';
    body.innerHTML = `<div class="state" style="grid-column:1/-1">
      ${icon('x-circle')}
      <h3>Could not load the timeline</h3>
      <p class="mono" style="font-size:11.5px">${esc(state.error)}</p>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" data-action="retry">${icon('reset')} Retry</button>
    </div>`;
    return;
  }

  const turn = state.turn;
  const sum = summarize(turn);
  const status = turn.events.some(e => e.status === 'error') ? 'err' : 'ok';
  const ticks = ticksFor(state.view);

  head.innerHTML = `
    <div class="panel-title">
      <h2>${esc(turn.name)}</h2>
      <span class="chatid">${esc(turn.chat_id)} · ${esc(turn.model)} · run ${esc(turn.events.find(e => e.kind === 'run').meta.run_id)}</span>
      <span class="pill ${status === 'err' ? 'err' : 'ok'}"><span class="dot ${status === 'err' ? 'err' : 'ok'}"></span>${status === 'err' ? 'failed' : 'completed'}</span>
      <div class="spacer" style="flex:1"></div>
      <div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Turn to inspect">
        ${Object.values(TURNS).map(t => `<button data-action="select-turn" data-turn="${t.id}"
          aria-pressed="${t.id === turn.id}"><span class="dot ${t.id === 't_C' ? 'err' : t.id === 't_B' ? 'warn' : 'ok'}"></span>${esc(t.name)}</button>`).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="metrics">
      <div class="metric"><span class="k">Total</span><span class="v">${fmtDur(sum.total)}</span></div>
      <div class="metric"><span class="k">LLM</span><span class="v">${fmtDur(sum.llm)}<small>${Math.round(sum.llm / sum.total * 100)}%</small></span></div>
      <div class="metric"><span class="k">Tools</span><span class="v">${fmtDur(sum.tool)}<small>${sum.tools} calls</small></span></div>
      <div class="metric"><span class="k">Subtasks</span><span class="v">${fmtDur(sum.sub)}</span></div>
      <div class="metric"><span class="k">Idle / wait</span><span class="v" style="color:${sum.idle / sum.total > 0.4 ? 'var(--warning)' : 'inherit'}">${fmtDur(sum.idle)}<small>${Math.round(sum.idle / sum.total * 100)}%</small></span></div>
      <div class="metric"><span class="k">Tokens</span><span class="v">${(sum.prompt + sum.completion).toLocaleString()}<small>in ${sum.prompt.toLocaleString()} / out ${sum.completion.toLocaleString()}</small></span></div>
      <div class="metric"><span class="k">Cost</span><span class="v">$${sum.cost.toFixed(3)}</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="toolbar">
      ${['llm', 'tool', 'subtask', 'io', 'events'].map(k => `
        <button class="chip" data-action="filter" data-kind="${k}" aria-pressed="${state.filters[k]}">
          <span class="sw" style="background:${{ llm: 'var(--info)', tool: 'var(--success)', subtask: 'var(--violet)', io: 'var(--warning)', events: 'var(--primary)' }[k]}"></span>
          ${{ llm: 'LLM', tool: 'Tools', subtask: 'Subtasks', io: 'Storage', events: 'Events' }[k]}
        </button>`).join('')}
      <span class="sep"></span>
      <button class="btn btn-icon" data-action="zout" aria-label="Zoom out">${icon('zout')}</button>
      <button class="btn btn-icon" data-action="zin" aria-label="Zoom in">${icon('zin')}</button>
      <button class="btn" data-action="fit" title="Fit the whole turn (F)">${icon('fit')} Fit</button>
      <button class="btn" data-action="replay" id="replay-btn" aria-pressed="${state.replay.playing}">
        ${icon(state.replay.playing ? 'stop' : 'play')} ${state.replay.playing ? 'Stop replay' : 'Replay'}
      </button>
      <span class="sep"></span>
      <span class="hint mono" id="window-lbl">${fmtT(state.view.start)} → ${fmtT(state.view.end)}</span>
    </div>`;

  body.innerHTML = `<div class="tl" id="tl">${timelineHTML(turn, ticks)}</div>
    <aside class="rail">
      ${insightsHTML()}
      ${detailsHTML()}
    </aside>`;

  collectNodes();
  updatePlayhead();
}

/* ── E.3 timeline (lanes + bars) ────────────────────────────────────────── */
function timelineHTML(turn, ticks) {
  const view = state.view;
  const f = state.filters;
  const guides = ticks.list.map(t => `<i class="guide" style="left:${pct(t, view).toFixed(3)}%"></i>`).join('');
  const ruler = ticks.list.map(t =>
    `<i class="tick" style="left:${pct(t, view).toFixed(3)}%"><span>${tickLabel(t, ticks.step)}</span></i>`).join('');

  const row = (labelHTML, barsHTML, h, cls) =>
    `<div class="gc ${cls || ''}" style="height:${h}px">${labelHTML}</div>
     <div class="track" style="height:${h}px">${guides}${barsHTML}<div class="playhead"></div></div>`;

  const eventsRow = f.events ? row(
    icon('flag') + '<span class="name">Events</span>',
    turn.events.filter(e => e.lane === 'events').map(e =>
      `<div class="marker k-${e.kind}" style="left:${pct(e.start, view).toFixed(3)}%"
        data-action="select-event" data-event="${e.id}" data-tip="${esc(e.label)}|${fmtT(e.start)}|${e.kind}"
        role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="${esc(e.label)} at ${fmtT(e.start)}"
        data-status="${e.status}" aria-selected="${state.selectedId === e.id}"></div>`).join(''), 22, 'lane') : '';

  const turnRow = row(icon('clock') + '<span class="name">Turn</span>',
    barHTML(turn.events.find(e => e.kind === 'run'), turn, 'k-run', 'Turn'), 26, 'lane');

  const llmRow = f.llm ? row(icon('zap') + '<span class="name">LLM</span>',
    turn.events.filter(e => e.kind === 'llm').map(e => llmBarHTML(e, turn)).join(''), 30, 'lane') : '';

  // tools: one row per call (DevTools waterfall)
  const tools = turn.events.filter(e => e.kind === 'tool');
  const toolsHead = f.tool ? row(
    `<button class="tl-gutter-btn" data-action="toggle-tools" style="all:unset;cursor:pointer;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;width:100%">
       ${icon(state.toolsOpen ? 'chevron-d' : 'chevron-r')} ${icon('wrench')}<span class="name">Tools (${tools.length})</span>
     </button>`, '', 22, 'group') : '';
  const toolRows = (f.tool && state.toolsOpen) ? tools.map(e => row(
    `<span class="name" data-action="select-event" data-event="${e.id}" title="${esc(e.label)} (${esc(JSON.stringify(e.meta.args || {}))})"
       class="${state.selectedId === e.id ? 'sel' : ''}" style="display:block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">${esc(e.label)}</span>`,
    barHTML(e, turn, 'k-tool' + (e.status === 'error' ? ' err' : ''), e.label), 22, 'tool')).join('') : '';

  const subRow = f.subtask && turn.events.some(e => e.kind === 'subtask') ? row(icon('branch') + '<span class="name">Subtasks</span>',
    turn.events.filter(e => e.kind === 'subtask').map(e => barHTML(e, turn, 'k-subtask', e.label)).join(''), 24, 'lane') : '';

  const ioRow = f.io ? row(icon('db') + '<span class="name">Storage</span>',
    turn.events.filter(e => e.kind === 'persist' || e.kind === 'socket').map(e => barHTML(e, turn, 'k-' + e.kind, e.label)).join(''), 22, 'lane') : '';

  return `
    <div class="tl-head">
      <div class="gutter-head">Lane</div>
      <div class="ruler" id="ruler">${ruler}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="tl-body" id="tl-body">
      ${eventsRow}${turnRow}${llmRow}${toolsHead}${toolRows}${subRow}${ioRow}
    </div>
    <div class="minimap" id="minimap"><div class="mm-inner" id="mm-inner">
      ${turn.events.filter(e => (e.dur || 0) > 0 && ['llm', 'tool', 'subtask', 'persist', 'socket'].includes(e.kind)).map(e =>
        `<span class="mm-seg" style="left:${(e.start / turn.duration * 100).toFixed(2)}%;width:${Math.max(e.dur / turn.duration * 100, .4).toFixed(2)}%;background:${
          e.status === 'error' ? 'var(--error)' : { llm: 'var(--info)', tool: 'var(--success)', subtask: 'var(--violet)', persist: 'var(--warning)', socket: 'var(--warning)' }[e.kind]}"></span>`).join('')}
      <div class="brush" id="brush"></div>
    </div></div>
    <div class="legend">
      <span class="it"><span class="sw" style="background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#4696DC66 0 3px,transparent 3px 6px);border:1px solid #4696DC66"></span>waiting for first token</span>
      <span class="it"><span class="sw" style="background:var(--info)"></span>reading response (stream)</span>
      <span class="it"><span class="sw" style="background:var(--success)"></span>tool</span>
      <span class="it"><span class="sw" style="background:var(--violet)"></span>subtask</span>
      <span class="it"><span class="sw" style="background:var(--warning)"></span>storage / socket</span>
      <span class="it"><span class="sw" style="background:var(--error)"></span>error</span>
      <span class="it" style="margin-left:auto">wheel = zoom · drag = pan · ↑↓ = walk events · F = fit</span>
    </div>`;
}

function barHTML(e, turn, cls, label) {
  if (!e || !e.dur) return '';
  const left = pct(e.start, state.view);
  const w = (e.dur / (state.view.end - state.view.start)) * 100;
  return `<div class="bar ${cls}" style="left:${left.toFixed(3)}%;width:max(${w.toFixed(3)}%,3px)"
    data-action="select-event" data-event="${e.id}" role="button" tabindex="0"
    aria-selected="${state.selectedId === e.id}"
    data-tip="${esc(label)}|${fmtDur(e.dur)}|${e.status}${e.meta.error ? ' · ' + esc(e.meta.error) : ''}">
    <span class="bar-label">${esc(label)}</span></div>`;
}

function llmBarHTML(e, turn) {
  const left = pct(e.start, state.view);
  const w = (e.dur / (state.view.end - state.view.start)) * 100;
  const wait = (e.meta.ttft || 0) / e.dur * 100;
  return `<div class="bar k-llm" style="left:${left.toFixed(3)}%;width:max(${w.toFixed(3)}%,4px)"
    data-action="select-event" data-event="${e.id}" role="button" tabindex="0"
    aria-selected="${state.selectedId === e.id}"
    data-tip="${esc(e.label)} · ${esc(e.meta.model || '')}|${fmtDur(e.dur)} · ttft ${fmtDur(e.meta.ttft)} · ${e.meta.tps || '?'} tok/s|ready">
    <span class="llm-wait" style="width:${clamp(wait, 0, 100).toFixed(2)}%"></span>
    <span class="llm-stream"></span>
    <span class="bar-label">${esc(e.label)}</span></div>`;
}

/* ── E.4 insights rail ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function insightsHTML() {
  const list = state.insights;
  const counts = { error: 0, warning: 0, info: 0 };
  list.forEach(i => counts[i.severity]++);
  const body = list.length === 0
    ? `<div class="empty">${icon('check')}No anomalies detected.<br>Every tool under 5s, no silent gaps, no repeated calls.</div>`
    : list.map((i, idx) => `
      <button class="insight ${i.severity}" data-action="insight" data-event="${i.eventId}">
        ${icon(i.severity === 'error' ? 'x-circle' : i.severity === 'warning' ? 'alert' : 'info')}
        <span>
          <span class="t">${esc(i.title)}</span>
          <span class="d">${esc(i.detail)}</span>
          <span class="when">${fmtT(i.at)}</span>
        </span>
      </button>`).join('');
  return `<div class="rail-card">
    <div class="rail-head">${icon('alert')}<h3>Insights</h3>
      <span class="count">${counts.error ? counts.error + ' err · ' : ''}${counts.warning ? counts.warning + ' warn · ' : ''}${counts.info} info</span>
    </div>
    ${body}
  </div>`;
}

/* ── E.5 details rail ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function detailsHTML() {
  const turn = state.turn;
  const e = state.selectedId ? turn.events.find(x => x.id === state.selectedId) : null;

  if (!e) {
    const sum = summarize(turn);
    return `<div class="rail-card">
      <div class="rail-head">${icon('info')}<h3>Details</h3><span class="count">turn</span></div>
      <div class="detail">
        <h4>${icon('clock')} ${esc(turn.name)}</h4>
        <div class="sub">${esc(turn.chat_id)} · ${esc(turn.profiles.join(', '))}</div>
        <dl class="dl">
          <dt>Started</dt><dd>${esc(turn.started_at)}</dd>
          <dt>Duration</dt><dd>${fmtDur(sum.total)}</dd>
          <dt>LLM rounds</dt><dd>${sum.rounds}</dd>
          <dt>Tool calls</dt><dd>${sum.tools}</dd>
          <dt>Events</dt><dd>${turn.events.length}</dd>
          <dt>Errors</dt><dd>${sum.errors || '—'}</dd>
        </dl>
        <p class="d" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-3);margin:10px 0 0">
          Select any bar or marker to inspect a single event.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }

  const rows = [
    ['Kind', e.kind],
    ['Status', e.status],
    ['Start', fmtT(e.start)],
    ['End', e.dur ? fmtT(e.start + e.dur) : fmtT(e.start)],
    ['Duration', e.dur ? fmtDur(e.dur) : 'instant']
  ];
  Object.keys(e.meta).forEach(k => {
    const v = e.meta[k];
    if (v == null || typeof v === 'object') return;
    rows.push([k.replace(/_/g, ' '), typeof v === 'number' && /ttft/.test(k) ? fmtDur(v) : v]);
  });
  const objects = Object.keys(e.meta).filter(k => e.meta[k] && typeof e.meta[k] === 'object');

  return `<div class="rail-card">
    <div class="rail-head">${icon(kindIcon(e.kind))}<h3>Details</h3><span class="count">${esc(e.kind)}</span></div>
    <div class="detail">
      <h4>${icon(kindIcon(e.kind))} ${esc(e.label)}
        <span class="pill ${e.status === 'error' ? 'err' : 'ok'}" style="margin-left:auto">${esc(e.status)}</span></h4>
      <div class="sub">${esc(e.id)} · lane ${esc(e.lane)}</div>
      <dl class="dl">${rows.map(([k, v]) => `<dt>${esc(k)}</dt><dd>${esc(v)}</dd>`).join('')}</dl>
      ${e.meta.error ? `<div class="errbox">${icon('alert')} ${esc(e.meta.error)}</div>` : ''}
      ${objects.map(k => `<pre class="pre">${esc(k)}: ${esc(JSON.stringify(e.meta[k], null, 2))}</pre>`).join('')}
      <div class="detail-actions">
        <button class="btn" data-action="zoom-event" data-event="${e.id}">${icon('zin')} Zoom to</button>
        <button class="btn" data-action="copy" data-event="${e.id}">${icon('copy')} Copy JSON</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

/* ── E.6 node bookkeeping (replay updates without re-render) ────────────── */
function collectNodes() {
  barNodes = new Map();
  playheads = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.playhead'));
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-event]').forEach(n => {
    if (n.classList.contains('bar') || n.classList.contains('marker')) barNodes.set(n.dataset.event, n);
  });
  updateBrush();
}

function updateBrush() {
  const brush = document.getElementById('brush');
  if (!brush || !state.turn) return;
  const d = state.turn.duration || 1;
  brush.style.left = (state.view.start / d * 100).toFixed(3) + '%';
  brush.style.width = ((state.view.end - state.view.start) / d * 100).toFixed(3) + '%';
}

function updatePlayhead() {
  const t = state.replay.t;
  playheads.forEach(p => {
    if (t == null) { p.classList.remove('on'); return; }
    p.classList.add('on');
    p.style.left = pct(t, state.view).toFixed(3) + '%';
  });
  if (state.turn && t != null) {
    barNodes.forEach((node, id) => {
      const e = state.turn.events.find(x => x.id === id);
      if (e) node.classList.toggle('pending', e.start > t);
    });
    const lbl = document.getElementById('window-lbl');
    if (lbl && state.replay.playing) lbl.textContent = 'replay ' + fmtT(Math.min(t, state.turn.duration));
  }
}

/* ============================================================================
   F. ACTIONS
   ============================================================================ */
async function loadTurn(id) {
  state.turnId = id;
  state.loading = true;
  state.error = null;
  state.selectedId = null;
  state.replay.playing = false;
  state.replay.t = null;
  saveState();
  renderChat();
  renderPanel();

  try {
    const res = await mockFetch(`/api/chats/${CHAT.id}/turns/${id}/timeline${state.forceFail ? '?_fail=1' : ''}`);
    if (!res.ok) {
      const body = await res.json();
      throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} ${body.error}${body.detail ? ' — ' + body.detail : ''}`);
    }
    const data = await res.json();
    state.turn = data;
    state.insights = data.insights || [];
    state.view = { start: 0, end: data.duration };
    state.loading = false;
  } catch (err) {
    state.loading = false;
    state.error = err.message || String(err);
  }
  renderPanel();
}

function selectEvent(id) {
  state.selectedId = id;
  renderPanel();
  const rail = document.querySelector('.rail-card:last-child');
  if (rail) rail.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });
}

function setView(start, end) {
  const d = state.turn ? state.turn.duration : 1;
  const minSpan = Math.min(1200, d);
  let span = clamp(end - start, minSpan, d);
  let s = clamp(start, 0, d - span);
  state.view = { start: s, end: s + span };
  renderPanel();
}

function zoomAt(factor, centerT) {
  const v = state.view;
  const span = v.end - v.start;
  const center = centerT == null ? (v.start + v.end) / 2 : centerT;
  const newSpan = clamp(span / factor, Math.min(1200, state.turn.duration), state.turn.duration);
  setView(center - newSpan / 2, center + newSpan / 2);
}

function zoomToEvent(id) {
  const e = state.turn.events.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (!e) return;
  const pad = Math.max((e.dur || 0) * 0.6, state.turn.duration * 0.03, 800);
  setView(e.start - pad, e.start + (e.dur || 0) + pad);
}

function startReplay() {
  if (!state.turn) return;
  if (state.replay.playing) { stopReplay(); return; }
  state.replay.t = 0;
  state.replay.playing = true;
  state.replay.last = performance.now();
  renderPanel();
  state.replay.raf = requestAnimationFrame(replayStep);
  toast('Replaying the turn in real time');
}

function replayStep(now) {
  if (!state.replay.playing || !state.turn) return;
  const dt = Math.min(80, now - state.replay.last);
  state.replay.last = now;
  const speed = state.turn.duration / 13000;           // whole turn in ~13s
  state.replay.t = Math.min(state.replay.t + dt * speed, state.turn.duration);
  updatePlayhead();
  if (state.replay.t >= state.turn.duration) { stopReplay(); return; }
  state.replay.raf = requestAnimationFrame(replayStep);
}

function stopReplay() {
  state.replay.playing = false;
  cancelAnimationFrame(state.replay.raf);
  const t = state.replay.t;
  state.replay.t = null;
  document.querySelectorAll('.bar.pending, .marker.pending').forEach(n => n.classList.remove('pending'));
  updatePlayhead();
  const btn = document.getElementById('replay-btn');
  if (btn) { btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false'); btn.innerHTML = icon('play') + ' Replay'; }
  const lbl = document.getElementById('window-lbl');
  if (lbl && state.turn) lbl.textContent = fmtT(state.view.start) + ' → ' + fmtT(state.view.end);
  if (t != null && t >= (state.turn ? state.turn.duration : 0)) toast('Replay finished');
}

let toastTimer = 0;
function toast(msg) {
  const el = document.getElementById('toast');
  el.textContent = msg;
  el.classList.add('on');
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('on'), 1900);
}

/* ── tooltip ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function showTip(target, x, y) {
  const tip = document.getElementById('tooltip');
  const [title, mid, tail] = (target.dataset.tip || '').split('|');
  tip.innerHTML = `<div class="tt-t">${esc(title)}</div><div class="tt-m">${esc(mid || '')}</div>` +
                  (tail ? `<div class="tt-m" style="color:var(--text-3)">${esc(tail)}</div>` : '');
  tip.classList.add('on');
  const r = tip.getBoundingClientRect();
  tip.style.left = Math.min(window.innerWidth - r.width - 10, Math.max(8, x + 14)) + 'px';
  tip.style.top = Math.min(window.innerHeight - r.height - 10, Math.max(8, y + 14)) + 'px';
}
const hideTip = () => document.getElementById('tooltip').classList.remove('on');

/* ============================================================================
   G. EVENTS (delegated — survives every re-render)
   ============================================================================ */
document.addEventListener('click', evt => {
  const el = evt.target.closest('[data-action]');
  if (!el) return;
  const a = el.dataset.action;

  if (a === 'select-turn') { loadTurn(el.dataset.turn); document.getElementById('panel').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }); }
  else if (a === 'select-event') { evt.preventDefault(); selectEvent(el.dataset.event); }
  else if (a === 'insight') { selectEvent(el.dataset.event); zoomToEvent(el.dataset.event); toast('Jumped to ' + (state.turn.events.find(x => x.id === el.dataset.event) || {}).label); }
  else if (a === 'zoom-event') { selectEvent(el.dataset.event); zoomToEvent(el.dataset.event); }
  else if (a === 'fit') { setView(0, state.turn.duration); }
  else if (a === 'zin') { zoomAt(1.6); }
  else if (a === 'zout') { zoomAt(1 / 1.6); }
  else if (a === 'replay') { startReplay(); }
  else if (a === 'toggle-tools') { state.toolsOpen = !state.toolsOpen; saveState(); renderPanel(); }
  else if (a === 'filter') {
    const k = el.dataset.kind;
    state.filters[k] = !state.filters[k];
    if (!state.filters[k] && k === 'llm') { /* keep selection */ }
    saveState(); renderPanel();
  }
  else if (a === 'toggle-fail') {
    state.forceFail = !state.forceFail;
    el.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(state.forceFail));
    el.classList.toggle('btn-primary', state.forceFail);
    loadTurn(state.turnId);
  }
  else if (a === 'toggle-strip') {
    state.showStrip = !state.showStrip;
    el.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(state.showStrip));
    saveState(); renderChat();
  }
  else if (a === 'retry') { loadTurn(state.turnId); }
  else if (a === 'reset') {
    try { localStorage.removeItem(LS_KEY); } catch (e) {}
    state.filters = { llm: true, tool: true, subtask: true, io: true, events: true };
    state.toolsOpen = true; state.showStrip = true; state.selectedId = null; state.forceFail = false;
    document.getElementById('fail-btn').setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    document.getElementById('fail-btn').classList.remove('btn-primary');
    document.getElementById('strip-btn').setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    loadTurn('t_B');
    toast('Mock reset');
  }
  else if (a === 'copy') {
    const e = state.turn.events.find(x => x.id === el.dataset.event);
    const txt = JSON.stringify(e, null, 2);
    (navigator.clipboard ? navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt) : Promise.reject())
      .then(() => toast('Event JSON copied'))
      .catch(() => toast('Copy blocked — JSON is in the console'));
    if (!navigator.clipboard) console.log(txt);
  }
});

/* zoom with the wheel over the timeline */
document.addEventListener('wheel', evt => {
  const tl = evt.target.closest('#tl');
  if (!tl || !state.turn) return;
  evt.preventDefault();
  const track = evt.target.closest('.track, .ruler, .minimap');
  const box = (track || tl.querySelector('.track')).getBoundingClientRect();
  const ratio = clamp((evt.clientX - box.left) / box.width, 0, 1);
  const centerT = state.view.start + ratio * (state.view.end - state.view.start);
  zoomAt(evt.deltaY < 0 ? 1.25 : 1 / 1.25, centerT);
}, { passive: false });

/* drag to pan (empty track area) + minimap brush */
let drag = null;
document.addEventListener('pointerdown', evt => {
  if (!state.turn) return;

  const brush = evt.target.closest('#brush');
  const mm = evt.target.closest('#minimap');
  const emptyTrack = evt.target.classList.contains('track');

  if (brush || mm) {
    const box = document.getElementById('mm-inner').getBoundingClientRect();
    const at = clamp((evt.clientX - box.left) / box.width, 0, 1) * state.turn.duration;
    if (mm && !brush) {
      const span = state.view.end - state.view.start;
      setView(at - span / 2, at + span / 2);
    }
    drag = { mode: 'brush', x: evt.clientX, start: state.view.start, end: state.view.end, box };
    evt.preventDefault();
    return;
  }
  if (emptyTrack) {
    const box = evt.target.getBoundingClientRect();
    drag = { mode: 'pan', x: evt.clientX, start: state.view.start, end: state.view.end, width: box.width };
    evt.target.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
  }
});

document.addEventListener('pointermove', evt => {
  if (!drag || !state.turn) return;
  if (drag.mode === 'pan') {
    const dt = (evt.clientX - drag.x) / drag.width * (drag.end - drag.start);
    setView(drag.start - dt, drag.end - dt);
  } else {
    const dt = (evt.clientX - drag.x) / drag.box.width * state.turn.duration;
    setView(drag.start + dt, drag.end + dt);
  }
});

document.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
  if (drag) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.track').forEach(t => t.style.cursor = '');
    drag = null;
  }
});

/* tooltips */
document.addEventListener('pointerover', evt => {
  const t = evt.target.closest('[data-tip]');
  if (t) showTip(t, evt.clientX, evt.clientY);
});
document.addEventListener('pointerout', evt => {
  if (evt.target.closest('[data-tip]')) hideTip();
});
document.addEventListener('pointermove', evt => {
  const t = evt.target.closest('[data-tip]');
  if (t) showTip(t, evt.clientX, evt.clientY);
});

/* keyboard: walk events, fit, replay */
document.addEventListener('keydown', evt => {
  if (evt.target.matches('input, textarea')) return;
  if (evt.key === 'Escape') { hideTip(); document.activeElement.blur(); return; }
  if (!state.turn || state.loading) return;

  if (evt.key === 'f' || evt.key === 'F') { setView(0, state.turn.duration); return; }
  if (evt.key === ' ' && evt.target === document.body) { evt.preventDefault(); startReplay(); return; }

  if (evt.key === 'ArrowDown' || evt.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    const list = state.turn.events.slice().sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
    let i = list.findIndex(e => e.id === state.selectedId);
    i = evt.key === 'ArrowDown' ? Math.min(list.length - 1, i + 1) : Math.max(0, i - 1);
    evt.preventDefault();
    selectEvent(list[i].id);
    zoomToEvent(list[i].id);
  }
});

/* ============================================================================
   H. BOOT
   ============================================================================ */
(function boot() {
  loadState();
  document.getElementById('strip-btn').setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(state.showStrip));
  loadTurn(state.turnId);
})();
</script>

# Chat turn timeline — feature design

**Status:** mockup (design only, no product code changed).
**Entry point:** [`01-mockup/index.html`](01-mockup/index.html) — open it directly in a browser.

A timeline visualisation of the **processing events of one chat message**, in the spirit of
the Chrome DevTools performance/network panels: one lane per concern, a shared time axis,
and an insights rail that flags the anomalies you would otherwise only find by reading logs.

---

## 1. Why

A chat turn is a black box that can take 1s or 90s. Today the product shows
`ChatEntryTimeline` (a vertical list of events) and `ToolEventRow` / `LifecycleEventRow`
rows — accurate but flat: you cannot see **where the time went**, **what overlapped**, or
**what stalled**. The turnaround data is already on the response message
(`Message.tool_events`, `Message.lifecycle_events`, run analytics), so the only missing
piece is the visualisation.

The design promise of the brand applies literally here:
*"the machine is working; here is exactly what it is doing, and here is where you take over."*

---

## 2. Screens & components

| Screen | Component | What must work |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chat thread | **In-message strip** (`strip`) | Compressed 11px strip of the turn inside the assistant message + `duration · rounds · tools`. Click → opens the full panel. |
| Chat turn panel | **Turn header + metrics** | Name, chat id, model, run id, status pill; metrics: total, LLM, tools, subtasks, idle/wait, tokens, cost. |
| Chat turn panel | **Toolbar** | Category filters, zoom −/+, Fit, Replay, visible window label. |
| Chat turn panel | **Waterfall** (`Waterfall`) | Sticky lane gutter + ruler, one row per lane, one row per tool call, instant markers, playhead. |
| Chat turn panel | **Minimap** | Whole-turn overview + draggable brush showing the visible window. |
| Chat turn panel | **Insights rail** | Deterministic checks (see §5), each jumps to the offending event and zooms to it. |
| Chat turn panel | **Details rail** | Everything about the selected event: kind, status, start/end/duration, meta, error; Zoom to / Copy JSON. |

### Lanes

| Lane | Row content | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Events` | instant markers: message sent, run error, turn done | magenta / red / green |
| `Turn` | root bar = the whole run | magenta → purple gradient |
| `LLM` | one bar per round: hatched **wait for first token** + solid **reading response (stream)** | info blue |
| `Tools` | one row per tool call, waterfall-packed | success green, red when failed |
| `Subtasks` | child chat spawned by the turn | violet |
| `Storage` | `persist message` / `sio emit` | amber |

---

## 3. Mock API contract

| Method | Path | Payload |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/api/chats/:chat_id/messages` | `{ chat: { id, name, project, messages[] } }` |
| `GET` | `/api/chats/:chat_id/turns/:turn_id/timeline` | `{ id, name, chat_id, model, profiles, duration, events[], insights[] }` |

Event shape — deliberately aligned with the real models in `api/codx/junior/db.py`
(`ToolEvent`, `LifeCycleEvent`):

```json
{
  "id": "e4",
  "kind": "tool",              // message | run | llm | tool | subtask | persist | socket | error | done
  "lane": "tools",             // events | turn | llm | tools | subtasks | io
  "label": "fetch_webpage",
  "start": 10700,              // ms from the turn start
  "dur": 7940,                 // null = instant event (marker)
  "status": "ok",              // ok | error
  "meta": { "args": { "url": "…" }, "response": "18.4 KB markdown", "cached": false }
}
```

Insight shape: `{ severity: "error|warning|info", title, detail, at, eventId }`.

Mapping to the shipping model when this becomes real:

| Timeline field | Source today |
| --- | --- |
| `run` event | `Message.lifecycle_events[]` (`status`, `run_id`, `duration_ms`, `error`) |
| `tool` event | `Message.tool_events[]` (`tool`, `request`, `response`, `output`, `duration_ms`, `status`, `error`) |
| `llm` event | run analytics (`prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, TTFT) + `LLM_*` `AgentEventType`s |
| `subtask` event | child `Chat` (`parent_id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, own analytics) |
| `storage` event | `ChatEventBridge` persist / `EventManager` emit |
| `error` marker | `Message.error`, `RUN_ERROR`, `TOOL_ERROR` |

---

## 4. What's mocked

- **3 turns** of one chat (`t_B` slow is the default, `t_A` healthy, `t_C` failed) with
  hand-written events that mirror the real shapes and edge cases.
- **`mockFetch`** — route table + 160–420ms latency + a `?_fail=1` failure injection wired
  to the *Force error* switch in the top bar.
- **Insights are computed at runtime** from the events (not hard-coded), so the rules are
  testable by switching turns.
- Seed data only: no network, no backend, no auth.
- `localStorage["mock.codx.timeline.v1"]` keeps the selected turn, filters, tool-row
  collapse state and strip visibility. *Reset mock* clears it.

---

## 5. Insight rules (deterministic, threshold-based)

| Rule | Threshold | Severity |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Run failure (`RUN_ERROR` / turn aborted) | any | error |
| Tool / LLM failure | any | error |
| Slow tool | `dur > 5s` | warning |
| Silent gap (no event, no heartbeat) | `gap > 8s` | warning |
| Same tool + identical arguments twice | any | warning |
| Slow first token (TTFT) | `ttft > 2.5s` | warning |
| Subtask holds the turn open | `dur > 15s` | warning |
| Low streaming throughput | `< 45 tok/s` | info |
| Retried after a tool error | `< 1s` later | info |

A turn with no match renders the empty state — *"No anomalies detected"* — which is the
healthy case, not a missing feature.

---

## 6. Try it

1. Default turn (`Slow turn`): 7 insights. Click **Slow tool · fetch_webpage** → the
   waterfall zooms to the 7.9s bar and selects it.
2. Click **Silent gap · 37.8s** → the window jumps to the empty stretch between

# codx-junior — Design Documentation

Corporate image and UI/UX foundation for **codx-junior**, derived from an audit of the
shipping product (`client/` — project `codx-junior-ui`).

> **Status:** v0.1 — *baseline definition*. Everything here describes either
> (a) what the product does **today**, verified in code, or (b) a **decision
> proposal** to close a gap. Each statement is labelled so the two never get
> confused.

> **Start here — [`playbook/index.html`](playbook/index.html).** The whole design system on
> one self-contained page: live component specimens, dark/light toggle, print-ready layout.
> Hand it to any developer before they write UI code.

---

## Why this folder exists

codx-junior grew feature-first: 400+ Vue components, several parallel shells
(desktop dockview, mobile app shell, company shell, solopreneur shell) and three
different colour palettes that leaked into the codebase over time. The product
works, but it does not yet look like *one company*.

This folder is the single place where the corporate image is defined, so that:

- a new screen can be designed without inventing new colours, spacing or copy;
- a designer and a developer can agree on a spec without a meeting;
- rebrand work (logo, palette, marketing site) has a contract to break *on purpose*.

---

## How to read it

| Folder | Contents | Audience |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `playbook/` | **The playbook** (`index.html`) — this whole folder on one page, with rendered specimens | Developers, new joiners |
| `resources/` | **Official artwork** — `logo.png` (the mark, 267 × 266 PNG + alpha) and `me-and-codx-junior.png` (brand photograph). Embedded by the playbook, taken from here, never re-exported | Everyone |
| `00-audit/` | What the current UI actually is, with file-level evidence | Designers, tech leads |
| `01-brand/` | Brand platform, logo, colour, typography, voice — the *corporate image* | Everyone, marketing included |
| `02-design-system/` | Foundations (space, radius, motion, layering) and component specs | Designers, frontend |
| `03-ux/` | Information architecture, navigation model, accessibility | Designers, PMs, frontend |
| `04-assets/` | Asset production rules: formats, sizes, naming, export | Design, marketing |
| `05-governance/` | Ownership, versioning, review checklist, adoption roadmap | Leads |
| `06-calendar/` | **Feature design** — agenda/calendar manager: deep analysis, clickable prototype, API fixtures. Design only, no code changed | Product, frontend, backend |
| `07-chat-timeline/` | **Feature design** — chat turn timeline (DevTools-style waterfall of a message's processing events) + insights rail. Clickable mockup, design only | Product, frontend, backend |
| `tokens/` | `design-tokens.json` — machine-readable source for the values above | Frontend |

Reading order for a newcomer: **audit → brand platform → colour → typography →
foundations → components → IA**.

---

## Ground rules

1. **The code is the current truth; this folder is the target truth.** When they
   disagree, the documents say which one wins.
2. **No new colour, radius or spacing value without a token.** If a value is
   missing, add a token here first, then use it.
3. **Every doc is versioned with the product**, not separately. See
   `05-governance/design-ops.md`.
4. **Numbers beat adjectives.** "16px, 8px grid, 4.5:1" is a spec; "modern and
   clean" is not.

---

## Source of truth (code references used throughout)

| Concern | File |
| --- | --- |
| Design tokens (live) | `client/src/assets/base.css` (Tailwind v4 + daisyUI 5) |
| Brand helper classes | `client/src/assets/main.css` (`--codx-primary` `#cc0099`, `--codx-secondary` `#8f008f`) |

| Logos / icons | `client/public/only_icon.png`, `client/public/favicon.ico` |

---

## One-paragraph summary of the brand (TL;DR)

**codx-junior** is an AI engineering companion for teams. It is calm, dense with
information and *fast to read*. Its corporate signature is a **magenta spectrum**
(`#CC0099` → `#FF69B4`) on a **deep blue-slate** canvas, with a **system UI
typeface** for the interface and a **monospace** for anything the machine said or
wrote. The visual promise is *"the machine is working; here is exactly what it is
doing, and here is where you take over."* Every design decision should make that
promise visible.

| 8 | Design system published as code (`tokens` → CSS variables) | ⬜ |

messages.content:
Place timeline as part of the chat message header (sticky).
Use different colors for each event type.
In the details show (in tabs):
 - Events table 
 - Tools section

I'll start by reading the current state of the header, the timeline component and the details panel.Now I have the full picture. Creating the shared visual vocabulary first (so the bar and the table can never drift apart):Now the timeline itself — family colours and the drawer trigger it inherits from the removed strip:Now the details panel with the two tabs:Now wiring it into the sticky header of the entry:Two data-quality fixes: offsets were suppressed when any row lacked a timestamp, and `browse_*` fell into "Tool":Now making the offsets match the bar geometry exactly (the backend records no per-event timestamps, so they are reconstructed from the same rule the bar uses):Found a real defect: the "Answer received" row took `updated_at` (which moves with read receipts/edits) instead of the turn duration — it showed `+23m02s` on a `10m 58s` turn:No delete tool available for that file — I'll leave it and flag it. Now a clean reload to verify from scratch (not from HMR state):Done and verified against the running app after a clean reload (not just HMR state).

## What changed

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `client/src/utils/toolVisuals.js` | **new** — the shared colour vocabulary: one place that maps a tool to its family (`read / edit / run / web / agent`), plus the visual of each event kind. The bar and the table import it, so a colour can never mean two things. |
| `client/src/components/chat/ChatTurnTimeline.vue` | moved into the header; **one colour per event type**; family chip in the hover card; takes over the `⋯` drawer button from the deleted strip |
| `client/src/components/chat/ChatMessageEvents.vue` | **tabs: `Events` (table) / `Tools` (wall)**, family legend, reconstructed offsets |
| `client/src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | timeline + panel are now rows **inside the sticky header**; the old end-of-message block and the `ChatEntryToolSummary` strip are gone |

## 1. Timeline in the message header (sticky)

The waterfall is now a full-width row of the header block itself (`sticky top-0 z-20`), not something at the end of the body. The details panel renders **inside the same sticky container**, directly under the bar, so bar and detail never separate. Measured while scrolled: header pinned at `top: 46`, bar at `86`, panel `118 → 491` in a 678 px viewport — all visible, no horizontal overflow at 1024 px.

## 2. A colour per event type

| Kind | Colour | | Kind | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Model / thinking | neutral | | Web (browser, fetch, search) | secondary |
| Read (read/get/list/search/locate) | info | | Agent (task, orchestrator, delegate…) | primary |
| Write (write/apply/save/patch/commit) | success | | Run lifecycle | accent |
| Execute (terminal/docker/git/build) | warning | | Error (any failed call) | error |

A **running** call keeps its family colour and only pulses, so an in-flight execute never looks like a read. Colour is never alone: the hover card shows the family chip in words, the table repeats it, and the legend counts it. Live bar now shows **6 distinct computed colours** on the 99-tool turn.

## 3. Details in two tabs

- **Events** — real table (`#`, `Offset`, `Event`, `Detail`, `Duration`): `message sent → run lifecycle → every tool call → answer received`. Verified on the completed 10m58s turn: 102 rows, `+0ms → +10m51s`, closing with `Answer received · +10m58s`. The failed call in the 55-tool turn is flagged red at `+4m44s` and counted as `Error 1` in the legend (`Read 19 · Web 28 · Tool 2 · Write 5 · Error 1`).
- **Tools** — the previous execution wall, unchanged, now with a family chip per row (99 rows on the long turn, 55 on another).

## Defects found by testing (and fixed)

1. **Offsets were all `—`** — tool events carry a duration but **no timestamp**. They are now reconstructed with the same rule the bar uses (unaccounted model time spread over the gaps), so a row's offset points where its segment sits.
2. **`Answer received` showed `+23m02s`** on a `10m58s` turn: it was reading `updated_at`, which moves with read receipts and edits. It now uses the turn duration.
3. **`browse_action` classified as "Tool"** — the web family now matches `browse|screenshot`.

## Two notes

- **Default tab is `Tools`** (the usual "what is it doing now" reading); `Events` is first in the order. Say the word and I flip the default.
- `client/src/components/chat/ChatEntryToolSummary.vue` is now **unreferenced** — its only unique feature (the `⋯` drawer) works from the timeline (verified: clicking it opens the side drawer). I have no delete tool here, so it's still on disk for you to remove.

The read-receipt countdown is the one thing I could not exercise: my own messages are read instantly for `gbrian`, so `seenPending` never fires in this session — that logic is untouched, only the paint moved.

I'll read the current state of the timeline component and its wiring in `ChatEntry.vue`.Now let me see how the parent passes `eventsOpen` down.Markup looks correct, so this needs runtime evidence. Let me check the browser and click the bar.The toggle *does* flip `aria-expanded`, but **no panel element exists in the DOM**. Let me inspect the panel component.Toggle state flips correctly — so the panel must be rendering hidden/clipped. Let me measure it.Panel renders (373px) but its `top` is **-42** — it's above the viewport. Screenshot to see the reality:Let me measure precisely what happens on click (scroll position, header position, visibility).The panel opens fine *from the bar button*. Let me hit-test the chevron and counter — the obvious affordances.Two defects confirmed with runtime evidence:

1. **The chevron and the counter are outside the toggle button** — 158 px of the 820 px pill (including the ⌄ affordance) do nothing on click.
2. **Sticky containment** — when the panel opens, the header grows to 458 px; if the message has less room left, CSS pushes the sticky header *above* the viewport (measured `header top: -114`, `panel top: -42`) so the details open off-screen.

Fixing both:Reloading and verifying hit-testing plus the sticky clamp case:New markup is live (0 nested buttons, `cursor: pointer`). Now a **real** click on the chevron:The chevron now hit-tests **inside** the toggle. Real click on it:The maths works when driven externally. Let me verify the shipped component actually contains the fix:The code is served, so it must be bailing. Let me inspect the live component instance.Found it: **`this.$el` is a fragment anchor** (multi-root template), so `getBoundingClientRect` throws and the fix silently died. Fixing with a real anchor:Fixed: panel now opens **fully visible** (118→491) and auto-scrolls. Now real click on the **counter** and the last message:Counter and chevron both toggle now. But one case opened **below the fold** (`panelTop 529`). Let me check whether the reveal runs too early:The method works when called manually — so on the click path the panel isn't in the DOM yet. Adding a frame-retry:All cases now open fully visible. Full sweep + keyboard + drawer button + tabs:Fixed — and it was two separate defects, both confirmed with runtime evidence before I touched anything.

## What was actually wrong

**1. Only the left third of the pill was clickable.** The toggle was a `<button>` wrapping just the bar; the counter (`67 tools · 6m 09s`) and the chevron `⌄` — the thing that *looks* like the expander — sat outside it. Measured: pill 820 px, button 662 px, and `elementFromPoint` on the chevron returned an element with `insideToggle: false`. Clicking the chevron did literally nothing.

**2. The panel opened off-screen (CSS sticky containment).** The panel renders inside the sticky header, so opening it grows the header from ~85 px to 458 px. A sticky box that no longer fits in the remaining space of its message gets pushed *above* the viewport — measured `header top: -114`, `panel top: -42`, i.e. the tabs and the top of the table were above the scroll viewport.

## Changes

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `client/src/components/chat/ChatTurnTimeline.vue` | the **whole pill** is now the toggle: `role="button"`, `tabindex="0"`, `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`, `@click` + `Enter`/`Space`, `cursor-pointer`, focus ring. The bar became a plain `div` (0 nested buttons left), so counter and chevron are part of the hit area. The `⋯` drawer button keeps `@click.stop` and still does not collapse the panel. |
| `client/src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | `toggleEventsPanel` → `revealEventsPanel()` on open: after the panel renders, if it is not fully inside the messages viewport, scroll so the message top aligns with the viewport top (header back in its natural, never-clamped position). |

**Bug found inside my own fix** (would have shipped silently): first version used `this.$el`, which is a **comment anchor** in this multi-root template — it threw `entry.getBoundingClientRect is not a function` and the fix did nothing. Now anchored on `$refs.seenProgressBar.closest('.sticky').parentElement`, with a `requestAnimationFrame` retry because the panel is created by the parent's flag and is not in the DOM on the first tick.

## Verified live (real click events, not just state)

- Chevron click → `aria-expanded` false→true, panel present. Counter click → opens, second click → closes. Both were dead before.
- Sweep over all rendered turns, each pill parked at the very bottom of the viewport (worst case): panel `118 → 491` inside a `46 → 594` viewport — **fully visible in every case**, previously `-42`.
- Keyboard `Enter` on the focused pill opens it.
- `⋯` drawer click leaves the panel open (`aria-expanded` stays `true`).
- Tabs switch: **Events 70 rows** (first row `1 +0ms Message sent SENT`) / **Tools** wall, with the family legend.
- No horizontal overflow, no Vite/HMR errors in the client log.

Live: http://gbrian.codxjunior.com/browser/b537d1d5-1db7-4517-8c3b-2fb3044ecdd4/ — the panel is open on the Events tab. Try the `⌄` and the counter: both expand now.

One thing I still have not exercised: the read-receipt countdown overlay (my own messages are read instantly for `gbrian`, so `seenPending` never fires here). That logic is untouched — only the paint moved with the bar into the header.

This is how it looks the messge header with the options menu opened to show all actions.
Redesign, post 3 @mockups here to review

I'll ground the redesign in the real header markup before mocking anything up.Now I have the real header anatomy. Two things jump out already: the `hidden @lg/panel:inline-flex` action row is dead in this build (the cascade bug found last turn), so the kebab is the only entry point — and the kebab drops *over* the waterfall counter. Building the three directions.Two problems the measurements caught: the menu body scrolls (11 items don't fit) and it sits low on the page. Fixing so every option is visible for the review.All three render correctly. Writing the design note and registering the folder.Built and verified. Three directions, one page, switchable in the tab bar — plus a design note with the evidence behind each decision.

## Files

| File | What |
| --- | --- |
| `design/08-message-header/01-mockup/index.html` | The three mockups (A/B/C), self-contained, no build, no network |
| `design/08-message-header/README.md` | Current anatomy with line evidence, 5 measured defects, decision matrix, implementation sketch |
| `design/README.md` | Index row for the new folder |

**Live:** http://gbrian.codxjunior.com/browser/b537d1d5-1db7-4517-8c3b-2fb3044ecdd4/ (tab bar toggles the three)

## What the current header actually does wrong

I read the real markup first, and three of the five defects are measurable, not stylistic:

1. **The `⋯` menu covers the waterfall it belongs to.** `dropdown-content` drops from the kebab, and the kebab is on the row directly above the bar — so opening the menu hides `67 tools · 6m 09s` and the `⌄`. Visible in your screenshot.
2. **The inline action row never renders.** Every inline action is `class="hidden @lg/panel:inline-flex …"`, and in this Tailwind v4 build `.hidden` beats the container variant at every width (the cascade bug from the last turn). So the flat 11-item list isn't a fallback — it's the *only* entry point.
3. **Four natures, one weight.** State change (archive), meta (date, clock), toggles (`✓✓`, wrench), identity (avatars) and menu (`⋯`) all render as ~11 px grey glyphs on one 28 px line. `Delete` sits one `Tab` below `Mark un-seen`.

## The three directions

**A · Grouped popover** — same trigger, organised content: *Reply · Copy · Inspect · Automate*, shortcut hints on the right edge, `✓` on active toggles, and a footer where `Delete` stands alone. Anchored to the **header block**, so it opens *below* the bar.
**B · Action palette** — one `Actions ⌘K` trigger; opens a filter field + category rail with counts (`Inspect 5`, `Danger 1`) and a footer teaching `↑↓ ↵ esc`. The only shape that survives 25 actions.
**C · Inline toolbar** — no overlay at all: 13 labelled chips expand in place inside the header; the bar shifts down one row and can never be covered.

**My recommendation: A now**, with C as the wide-panel form later — they share markup (A is C with the labels hidden). B only if you want to claim `⌘K`.

## Verified in the browser (measured, not eyeballed)

- **Occlusion gone in all three:** A popover `458→989` vs waterfall bottom `443`; B `454→1084` vs `443`; C toolbar `417→489`, waterfall pushed to `506`.
- **Every action visible without scrolling:** A 12 items, B 15 items (uncapped for review — noted in each legend that the product caps at `60vh` and scrolls).
- **Icon column aligned** — all 12 A rows and all 15 B rows share one icon x (686 / 626). The current menu doesn't.
- **Contrast:** menu label 8.07:1, section label 5.02:1, counter 5.12:1, delete 5.06:1, body 8.49:1 — all ≥ AA.
- 138 bar segments, 7 distinct family colours, no horizontal overflow at 1024 px, trigger toggles the surface in A and C, one variant visible at a time.

Two caveats: I judged the layouts by geometry and DOM audit rather than by eye, so the *aesthetic* call is yours — and the mockup shows the header's actions always visible; today they are too, so that's a like-for-like comparison, but it's an open question in the README (§6).
